data.title: Remote Work Policy
data.summary: Eligibility, expectations, and equipment for working remotely.
data.content:
# Remote Work Policy

Staff Members may work remotely up to **3 days per week** with manager approval.

## Eligibility
- Completed probation
- Role suitable for remote work

## Expectations
- Available during **core hours** 10:00–16:00
- Reliable internet and a quiet workspace

## Equipment
The company provides a laptop and a monthly stipend for home-office costs.
data.author: People Ops

data.title: Design Review Process
data.summary: Stage-gated design reviews for aircraft and spacecraft programs.
data.content:
# Design Review Process

Every program follows **stage-gated reviews** along the systems-engineering V.

## Gates
- **PDR** — Preliminary Design Review
- **CDR** — Critical Design Review
- **TRR** — Test Readiness Review

## Rules
- Requirements must be **traceable** to verification
- Raise risks early; log them in the risk register
data.author: Systems Engineering

data.title: Incident Response Runbook
data.summary: Steps to triage, contain, and report a security incident.
data.content:
# Incident Response

## 1. Detect
Confirm the incident and its scope.

## 2. Contain
Isolate affected systems immediately.

## 3. Eradicate & Recover
Remove the cause and restore service.

## 4. Report
File a post-incident review within **48 hours**.
data.author: Security

data.title: Sales Commission Plan
data.summary: How commission tiers and accelerators work.
data.content:
# Sales Commission

Commission is paid monthly based on closed-won revenue.

## Tiers
- 0–80% quota: base rate
- 80–100%: +1.5x
- Above 100%: **2x accelerator**
data.author: RevOps

data.title: Expense Reimbursement
data.summary: Submitting and getting approval for work expenses.
data.content:
# Expense Reimbursement

Submit expenses within **30 days** via the finance portal.

## Approved
- Travel and lodging
- Team meals
- Software subscriptions (pre-approved)

Receipts are **required** for all claims.
